run_language_modeling_training: run language modeling fine-tuning on a text file with GPT, BERT, or RoBERTa models
train_model_with_mlm: train a masked language modeling model with configurable mask probability and block size
evaluate_model_perplexity: evaluate a trained language model and compute perplexity on an evaluation dataset
create_text_dataset: create a text dataset from a file by tokenizing and splitting into fixed-size blocks
rotate_checkpoints: rotate model checkpoints by deleting older ones beyond the configured save total limit
